findings.quote: We, in this context, considered the establishment of a regional center for artificial intelligence in Dushanbe to be favorable.
findings.rationale: Discusses AI for SDGs, a UN resolution on Central Asian AI and a regional centre.

findings.quote: This center would undoubtedly facilitate an implementation of joint initiatives and projects among Central Asian countries in the field of artificial intelligence.
findings.rationale: Explains the proposed centre's role in regional AI cooperation.
